name: launch
note: The music-led launch film: soft, short, mid-register effects mixed against the music bed instead of at a fixed level. Every role names its level over the bed (bed_db: the mix's loudest 50 ms at the effect over the music's median 50 ms level in the second before the cue), where it sits against the cut (offset_ms: taps, knocks and clicks lead, pop-in thumps and whoosh and swell peaks land after) and how close a run may go (min_gap_ms); ticks and bells are set wide. The numbers are house numbers for music-led films; the members are the earshot 0.4 recipe sounds made for that style (ui_pop, knock, cut_hit, mallet, shutter, the thump-whoosh, the dark riser and swell, the mid ding). level_db is the same balance for a mixer without a bed (the loudest role at 0 dB). One gesture at a time: the music steps down before a hit, a drop, a big whoosh or a swell and comes back on it; nothing ducks under the effects. Every take passes the model-free audit (earshot kit check).

tick.note: cast for detent: a small mechanical tick, a detent clicking over; 3 event(s)

tick.crisp.note: cast for detent: a small mechanical tick, a detent clicking over; 1 event(s)

tock.note: a mid-band wooden knock (0.15 s, 400 Hz block): knocks lead the cut by ~40 ms

hit.note: cast for logo-lock: one clean low hit under a logo; 1 event(s)

land.note: cast for card-land: a card or a sheet landing on a table; 2 event(s)

land.light.note: a light finger tap (150-260 Hz and a faint click), low under the bed: taps lead the cut by ~60 ms

pop.note: cast for appear: a soft rounded pop, something appearing; 7 event(s)

whoosh.short.note: cast for whip: a fast air whoosh, a whip pan; 3 event(s)

whoosh.long.note: cast for pass: a big low whoosh, a scene passing; 1 event(s)

riser.note: a short dark riser (0.8 s, noise + sub + a speeding stutter, no synth sweep), its peak ~23 ms before the cut and its fall across it (it rings on past its loudest point, so it is aligned on the peak, not its end); at most one or two a film

swell.note: a darker near-mono reverse swell peaking ~42 ms after the cut; at most one a film (reverse_swell/cymbal for the bright wide cymbal)

drop.note: a short kick-led sub hit (0.22 s) on the cut; set edits.pitch to the film's root

key.note: cast for type: a mechanical keyboard key press; 1 event(s)

key.space.note: a mechanical keyboard space bar, a CC0 recording fitted as code

key.return.note: cast: the typing run's own switch on its own seeds

click.note: cast for press: a soft mouse or button click; 1 event(s)

click.confirm.note: cast for success: a soft rounded ding, a success; 4 event(s)

snap.note: a camera shutter for snap zooms and whip-cuts (fit/snap/switch_flip for a toggle)

bell.note: a gated glockenspiel note doubled an octave under (0.35 s), C pentatonic G4-E6, set wide (L / R correlation 0.6): notes lead the cut by ~20 ms

text.note: cast for text: a soft plucked or tapped note; 5 event(s)

whoosh.short.swipe.note: cast for swipe: a card or a page swiped across a surface; 1 event(s)

whoosh.short.shape.note: cast for shape: a soft air transition through a shape; 1 event(s)

land.land.note: cast for land: a soft low thump, something landing; 2 event(s)

off.suck: off: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a lead-in on the hit; the music stop-down does that job

stop_down.release: on the hit: the music comes back with it

base.note: one soft felt pluck per resolved fragment (C pentatonic C4-A4), low under the bed
a fast air whoosh (0.37 s, 570 Hz): its peak lands ~37 ms after the cut (swish/bright for a brighter 2.4 kHz flick)
a round low pop-in thump (124 Hz, 0.18 s): it lands ~30 ms after the cut
a big low whoosh that lands with a thump ~80 ms in and rings ~0.35 s
an airy 8.8 kHz tick (60 ms), set fully wide: ticks come in runs ~66 ms apart; felt in the run, as low over the bed as the light touches
a bright designed tink for the crisper tick, a little wide
a rounded mid ding (690 Hz, 32 ms onset), the accent at the end of a run
the soft rounded mid pop (0.14 s, 550 Hz, 22 ms onset, t20 75 ms): the most used effect, in runs ~114 ms apart
realistic mid keys (1.3-4.4 kHz), a new take per keystroke, ~87 ms apart in a run
a small plastic click, a CC0 recording fitted as code: clicks lead the cut by ~11 ms
one short punchy cut hit (0.28 s, two thirds under 150 Hz), on the cut, after the music steps down
the run's own switch on its own seeds, a little louder
